STRATEGY PATTERN FOR PAYMENTS — BR13, BR14, NFR2
one class per method; a new method adds no edit here
FR-P1 — the actor filter lives here
Why this is the right structure for BR13 (NFR2)
OrderService asks the resolver for an IPaymentStrategy and never names a gateway. A new method is
one class implementing this interface plus one DI registration line: no existing class is edited, and the
actor restriction of BR13 stays inside IsAvailableFor, next to the method it belongs to.
